main_text.p: rum recentium, quorum Antecessores ob eafdem Hæreses, fædafque S. Paginæ corruptelas, jam olim explosi sunt, & Anathemate percussi; utpote qui nova, & monstrosa, & à fide Catholica plane abhorrentia, propalaverint? Quos Judices statuemus in hac Re, an sc. Doctrina tradita sit consona fidei Analogiæ, perpetuæque Scripturæ Harmoniæ, an cum ea discordet? Num existimabimus Patres Catholicos, vel eam prorsus ignorasse vel ex Consilio, & scientes impugnasse? Certe illi Dogmata sua, quæ cum in libris à se contra Hæreticos conscriptis defenderunt; tum Synodicis Decretis contra eosdem firmarunt, non tantum huic Fidei Analogiæ, seu perpetuæ Scripturæ Harmoniæ, in majoris momenti Articulis, omnino conformia judicarunt, sed & ejusdem partem non exiguam. Et ex adverso, omnes Catholici, tum hujus ævi, tum prioris cujusque ab ipsa Christianismi origine, Socinianorum Placita, ut ei adversantia, in totum repudiarunt.

§. 105. 13. Idem Socinus in Epist. 3. ad Matt. Radecium, & in modo dicto Tract. de Ecclesia, prope finem; plurimum tribuit Authoritati veterum, ut fortius afltruat Invocationem & Adorationem Christi contra Francisco-Davidianos. Verba antehac citavi, in quibus hæc occurrunt observanda. Primo, Christi Deitatem agnoscere cogitur, dum ait, Eum fuisse unum illum Deum, qui omnia ex Nihilo creavit, vel saltem ex illius substantia genitum; juxta Sententiam veterum, qui in hoc errare non potuerunt. Deinde quod pro apertissima veritate habendum sit, & mordicus retinendum, quicquid traditum habemus ab antiquis Ecclesiæ Doctoribus, pietatis & eruditionis nomine celeberrimis, & à sanctissimis Martyribus,

page.notes: Page is slightly skewed and the top-right corner shows show-through from the reverse page. The line "Deinde quod pro apertissima" and the word "Martyribus" (line-end) are italic; the last word of the page, "tyribus," is partially cut by the signature area, so it is read as "tyribus," with the final comma uncertain. The word "ex" in "ex adverso" and "ꝑ" forms do not occur here. The word "Martyribus" is partly obscured by the gathering mark and may be misread. The catchword "R 3" is actually a gathering signature and is recorded in the bottom margin only as a catchword; the true catchword "tyribus," appears at the right beneath the last line and should be treated as the catchword instead. Italic text in the last lines is set in italic; the line "Deinde quod pro" shows partial bold-like rendering and may be imperfectly read.
